stages.label: Public design commentary
stages.description: Project authors published a commentary on barriers to sharing psychiatric speech data.

stages.label: Barriers identified
stages.description: The commentary identified multiple barriers, including resistance arising from institutional interpretations of regulations and public perceptions, as well as transcription and file-organization workload.

stages.label: Access responses described
stages.description: The commentary described multiple consent, governance, vetting, agreement, password, and purpose-limitation responses rather than one universal access rule.

stages.label: Repository support funded
stages.description: AdminView creation received NIH FAIR grant funding.

stages.label: Graduated access architecture documented
stages.description: TalkBank documented open, registration-required, approved, and controlled access levels.

stages.label: PsychosisBank controlled access and conditional controls
stages.description: The policy placed PsychosisBank under controlled access with interview and CITI-training requirements; guidance also specified consent-, clinical-data-, and video-related controls.

edges.relationship: authors identified barriers in the published commentary
edges.reasoning: The authors published a commentary identifying barriers to psychiatric speech-data sharing.

edges.relationship: barriers were followed by proposed consent and governance responses
edges.reasoning: The commentary identifies barriers and describes multiple possible responses, including vetted access and governance controls.

edges.relationship: the commentary and later funding occurred before the current policy snapshot
edges.reasoning: The 2022 commentary describes responses, and AdminView funding is reported for 2023.
edges.missing_test: Seek contemporaneous project records or an AdminView change history linking the described responses to the 2023 implementation.

edges.relationship: funding preceded the documented access architecture
edges.reasoning: AdminView funding is reported for 2023, while TalkBank's four access levels are documented in the 2026 policy snapshot.

edges.relationship: the documented access architecture includes controlled PsychosisBank access and conditional controls
edges.reasoning: TalkBank documents four access levels, places PsychosisBank in controlled access, and specifies stronger controls for particular data and consent conditions.

established_summary: In 2022, the authors identified several barriers to sharing psychiatric speech data and described multiple consent and governance responses. AdminView funding was reported in 2023. The later TalkBank policy documents four access levels and places PsychosisBank in controlled access with interview and training requirements, alongside conditional controls for sensitive data and media.
unresolved_summary: The available record does not connect the 2022 proposed responses or the 2023 funding directly to the eventual PsychosisBank access selection. The same observed policy outcome remains compatible with burden and risk deliberation, external constraints, or an established TalkBank routine; contemporaneous decision records, policy history, and project-specific ethics determinations are needed to trace that transition.
